Profile details

Controls identity, links, email sender defaults, and the generated theme mode.

Shown on generated auth screens and email headers when set. Use an absolute URL that email clients can load.
Used when a logo is shown. Keep it short, like "Acme logo".
Optional reversed logo for the dark theme. Falls back to Logo URL when empty. Email always uses Logo URL, never this one.
System follows the user's device setting. Light or Dark forces generated auth screens into that theme.
Adds a Support link to generated auth screen footers. Leave blank to hide it.
Adds a Privacy link to generated auth screen footers. Leave blank to hide it.
Adds a Terms link to generated auth screen footers. Leave blank to hide it.
Display name recipients see on generated auth emails.
Sender address for generated auth emails. Use an address your mailer is allowed to send from.
Replies go to this address when set. Leave blank to use the sender address.
